title: Sharp cycle and boundary stabilization bounds for a half-plane couple
statement: theorem halfPlane_sharp_bounds {B : Type u₂} [Category.{v₂} B] [Abelian B] (X : BigradedExactCouple B 0) (a : ℤ) (hD : ∀ p q : ℤ, q < a → IsZero (X.D p q)) (hE : ∀ p q : ℤ, (p < 0 ∨ q < a) → IsZero (X.E p q)) : (∀ (r : ℕ) (p q : ℤ), 2 ≤ r → (p < 0 ∨ q < a) → IsZero (X.page r p q)) ∧ (∀ (r : ℕ) (p q : ℤ), 2 ≤ r → ¬ IsZero (X.page r p q) → a ≤ q ∧ q ≤ p + q ∧ 0 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ p + q - a) ∧ X.IsBounded ∧ (∀ (r : ℕ) (p q : ℤ), 2 ≤ r → max (q - a + 1) p < (r : ℤ) → (X.pageCouple (r - 2)).d p q = 0 ∧ (X.pageCouple (r - 2)).dInto p q = 0) ∧ (∀ (p q : ℤ) (t : ℕ), max 2 (max (q - a + 2) (p + 1)) ≤ (t : ℤ) → X.cycleBoundaryTower.Z (t - 2) p q = X.cycleBoundaryTower.Z ((max 2 (max (q - a + 2) (p + 1))).toNat - 2) p q ∧ X.cycleBoundaryTower.B (t - 2) p q = X.cycleBoundaryTower.B ((max 2 (max (q - a + 2) (p + 1))).toNat - 2) p q) ∧ X.IsRegular ∧ (∀ (r : ℕ) (p q : ℤ), q - a < (r : ℤ) → imageSubobject (X.incomingAlphaIter r p q) = ⊥) ∧ X.IsComplete

proof.text:
Each later E term is a subquotient of the initial E term, so induction
preserves its lower-half-plane support. A nonzero term therefore has p>=0 and
q>=a; on a total-degree diagonal this leaves finitely many indices, proving
boundedness. The outgoing differential has zero target when r>q-a+1, and the
incoming differential has zero source when r>p. The defining recurrences for
cycles and boundaries then become equalities from max(2,q-a+2,p+1) onwards;
induction gives the displayed equalities with their initial stable values.
This proves regularity. The source of the incoming alpha iterate is D(p+r,q-r),
zero when r>q-a, so its image is bottom. For each bidegree these images are
therefore eventually bottom, proving completeness.
